headline: Crypto Selloff Wipes Out $1.5 Billion in Leveraged Positions
summary: A sharp drop in Bitcoin, ether, and XRP triggered $1.5 billion in liquidations of leveraged crypto positions. Bullish bets accounted for nearly 84% of forced closures before a rebound caught short sellers.
why: Cryptocurrency liquidations reflect leverage dynamics across digital asset exchanges and can drive rapid volatility across the asset class.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Mass forced closures of leveraged long positions exacerbate downward spot price momentum.
